title: failure-demuxer-playlist-and-filtering-proposal
content:
Context:
This doc proposes a new Console view pattern called the 'Failure Demuxer' — a playlist-style debugging surface that helps engineers triage noisy streams of inference failures (timeouts, 5xx infra errors, model hallucinations, and content-policy rejects). Goal is to give SREs, infra, and model owners a single place to filter, group, prioritize, and action error events with minimal context switching.

Problem statement / Signals:
- Support teams spend too much time hunting for reproducible examples in a pile of events. Often duplicates or near-duplicates hide critical but rare root causes.
- Current "error timeline" and "session inspector" views surface raw events but lack good de-dup, fuzzy-grouping, and prioritization by customer impact or cost.
- We get noisy alerts from transient infra issues that drown out model-quality regressions. Teams want an ordered queue (playlist) of candidate failures that matter.

High-level concept:
- Failure Demuxer = a curated, sortable playlist of error events. Each playlist item is an aggregated/representative event (1:many mapping) with metadata: error class, first/last seen, incidence count, impacted routes/models, approximate cost impact (token/time), and confidence score for root cause bucket.
- Primary interactions: filter (by error type, model, region, customer tier), group (fuzzy by prompt similarity / stack trace signature), pin/ignore, assign to owner, open deep-inspector (existing session trace), and enqueue for replay.
- Playlist is ordered by a composite priority score (default: impact_score = occurrences * avg_latency_penalty * customer_severity_weight), with user-controlled weights.

Wireframe notes (low fidelity):
- Layout: three-column main canvas
  - Left: Filter rail (error type checkboxes, model dropdown, date window, region, customer tier, anomaly score slider).
  - Middle: Playlist (vertical stack). Each item shows: icon (timeout/5xx/model), compact sparkline of occurrences over time (last 24h), short sample input, representative output/error snippet, tags (auto: "rate-limit", "kv-cache-miss", "quantization-glitch"), quick actions: Assign / Ignore / Replay / Open Trace. Clicking expands to reveal timeline and sample traces.
  - Right: Context pane (selected playlist item) with tabs: Overview, Samples (3 examples), Stack & Logs, Trace waterfall (calls to model, region, fallback), Suggested fix actions (auto-suggested by pattern: e.g., increase timeout to X ms, switch to model-variant v1-quant), and Related Incidents.

Interaction details / Microflows:
- Fuzzy grouping: backend returns a cluster_id for events using a similarity function (prompt fingerprint + top-k stack signatures). UI displays cluster name and representative sample. User can merge/split clusters in the playlist.
- Priority tuning: user can open a small editor to tweak weights (occurrence, latency, customer_sev, cost) and save to a view. Views can be saved and shared.
- Replay flow: Enqueue > choose environment (staging/production-dry-run) > set input sample > run > results appended to replay log. Replay errors appear as separate items but are linked back to cluster_id.
- Assign/owner: Assign pushes a ticket to linked tracker (JIRA) and adds owner badge. Optionally escalate to on-call with a one-click.

Backlog grooming (candidate epics and tickets):
- EPIC: Playlist core scaffolding (UI list, filters, selection)
  - FE-101: Implement playlist layout and item card (8d)
  - FE-102: Filter rail + saved views (5d)
  - BE-201: playlist aggregation API (cluster summary endpoint) (6d)
  - BE-202: priority scoring service + tunables (4d)
- EPIC: Demuxer deep-inspector integration
  - FE-111: Context pane tabs + stack trace viewer (5d)
content_continued:
- BE-211: expose trace waterfall and logs linkage (5d)
- EPIC: Replay & queue management
  - FE-121: Replay modal and result log (4d)
  - BE-221: replay sandbox runner + dry-run flag (7d)
- EPIC: Auto-suggest & remediation hints
  - ML-301: pattern matcher for common fixes (timeouts -> raise deadline, cache-miss -> cache warmup) (10d)
  - FE-131: Render suggestions and CTA buttons (3d)
- EPIC: Access controls & RBAC for playlist operations (assign/ignore/escalate)
  - SEC-401: permission checks and audit trail (5d)

Acceptance criteria (MVP):
- Playlist shows aggregated items (min fields: type, count, first_seen, last_seen, representative sample) and supports primary filters (model, error type, region).
- Clicking an item opens context pane with at least 3 sample events and a link to an existing session trace.
- Users can assign an item which creates a JIRA ticket stub with cluster metadata.
- Saved view persists filter+tuning weights per user.

Open questions / tradeoffs:
- How aggressive should fuzzy grouping be? Risk: over-aggregation can hide distinct root causes. Proposal: conservative default thresholds, expose split/merge UI for manual correction.
- Real-time vs snapshot: do we stream new events into playlist or require refresh? Streaming is more delightful but will add scale complexity. Suggest MVP snapshot (poll every 30s) with opt-in live mode.
- Cost estimate accuracy: we need good heuristics for per-event token counts + infra duration. Backend telemetry team to propose fields.

Mockup copy snippets (for designers):
- Playlist item title: "Timeout cluster — 3 routes — 412 occurrences"
- Representative sample text: "User prompt: summarize monthly revenue by region -> Response: <timeout>"
- Suggested fix CTA: "Try raising handler timeout to 6s (estimated impact: reduce 72% of occurrences)"

Edge cases / UX decisions:
- Long-running clusters: allow pinning to a workspace board so teams can track remediation across sprints.
- Noise suppression: auto-ignore items with incidence < 3 in last 72h (configurable).
- Privacy: redact PII automatically in representative samples. Add an explicit "show raw" toggle for users with appropriate access.

Grooming notes (meeting snippets, 2025-11-12):
- Ravi: want quick heuristic for "model vs infra" cause — propose a confidence score computed from latency distribution and rate of 5xx across regions.
- Maya: replay must not hit prod models by default. Dry-run mode to emulate only.
- Liam: add a column for "customer impact score" derived from customer SLA tier and request rate.

Next steps / owner action items:
- Product: refine priority scoring formula and share with backend telemetry (owner: Ava, due 2025-11-20)
- Design: low-fidelity frames for playlist item and context pane (owner: Maya, due 2025-11-24)
- Backend: prototype cluster summarization endpoint (owner: Ravi, spike due 2025-11-28)
- SE/Oncall: review escalation flow and permissions matrix (owner: Liam, due 2025-12-02)

Notes to self / informal bits:
- Quick idea: "playlist templates" for SLO types (latency-SLO, correctness-SLO) — users can switch templates to reorder priorities.
- Consider integrating with Optimize: show quantization/model-variant suggestion side-by-side with impact estimate.
- Keep UX keyboard-friendly (j/k to jump items, r to replay, a to assign) — saves researchers' time during incident war rooms.

References:
- Linked Confluence spec (see top), JIRA-REQ-789 for requirements stub, prototype PR with early hi-fi wires in GitHub.
